title: Inference Log Retention Exception Register
author: Hannah Schmitt
content:
# Overview
This register lists customer-specific exceptions to the default inference request log retention policy.

**Default (for reference):** payload 30 days; metadata 90 days.

# Active exceptions (payload retention differs from default)
| Customer | Deployment | Payload retention | Metadata retention | Regions | Approved by | Approval date | Evidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northstar Bank | Dedicated | 0 days (disabled) | 30 days | us-east | Priya Natarajan | 2025-02-11 | INT-1842; Slack #eng-security thread 1739276405; email thread in aisha_rahman mailbox | Customer prohibits storage of prompts/completions. Only metadata retained for troubleshooting. |
| Helio Health | Hosted API (Enterprise) | 7 days | 90 days | eu-west | Hannah Schmitt | 2025-06-03 | INT-1907; contract addendum (Drive) | Shorter payload retention for GDPR posture. |
| QuantaGov | Private (VPC) | 180 days | 365 days | us-east | Avery Johnson | 2025-10-22 | INT-1974; security questionnaire response in gmail/olga_petrov | Longer retention required for audit trail; additional access controls enabled. |

# How to update
1) Confirm Security approval exists in Jira (internal-support).
2) Confirm customer acceptance exists (email or contract addendum).
3) Add a new row above and update last_updated.

# Caveats
- This register is intended as the source of truth, but historically some approvals were communicated in Slack first; always verify Jira and customer comms for final terms.
